chapters.reason: The paper explicitly modifies the Transformer architecture to implement recursive layer-tying, creating a loop structure that treats depth as a dynamic computational resource.
The authors introduce specific training strategies, including initialization from pretrained models and the use of depth-wise LoRA modules to optimize the recursive structure.
The approach involves converting existing, fixed-architecture pretrained Transformers into recursive models with minimal retraining, aligning with the concept of architecture distillation.
